cml.actionGoal: Link the written numeral to the exact amount it names for kcw show amount.
invariants: A numeral is a written promise about an amount: it records the last word of a careful count, position gives each digit its job, and the promise survives any change of objects or arrangement — the anchor for kcw show amount.
misconceptions: Treating numerals as decorations, reading digit pairs without position, or matching a numeral to roughly rather than exactly its amount.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one more thing joined the group, which single mark of the numeral would have to change?
